_comment: Sensor numbers and geolocation errors for altimetryFit (the defaults in altimetryFit/sensors.py).
Use with fit_altimetry.py --sensor_config_file, or set the environment variable ALTIMETRYFIT_SENSOR_CONFIG to its path.
Entries given replace the defaults; a given altimeters entry replaces the whole set of altimeters.
DEMs are numbered from one more than the largest altimeter number.  CS2_swath must be CS2_POCA+1.
geolocation_error: expected horizontal geolocation error (m) by altimeter name, DEM, or other (for --slope_bias_from_z0 and --DEM_slope_bias_scale).
